type Account = { balance: Int }

type Money = { cents: Int }

type Cart = { cents: Int }

type AppError = NotFound | Invalid

type OtherError = Oops

fn label(n: Int) -> Text
  example label(1) == "1"
do
  return n
end fn

fn add_text(a: Int, b: Text) -> Int
  example add_text(1, "x") == 1
do
  return a + b
end fn

fn first(xs: List<Int>) -> Int
  example first([1]) == 1
do
  return list.get(xs, 0)
end fn

fn lookup(id: Int) -> Result<Int, AppError>
  example lookup(1) == ok(1)
do
  return ok(id)
end fn

fn wrong_err(id: Int) -> Result<Int, OtherError>
  example wrong_err(1) == ok(1)
do
  let v = lookup(id)?
  return ok(v)
end fn

fn bad_field(a: Account) -> Int
  example bad_field({balance: 1}) == 1
do
  return a.cash
end fn

fn ambiguous() -> Int
  example ambiguous() == 1
do
  let m = {cents: 5}
  return 1
end fn

fn bad_call(a: Account) -> Int
  example bad_call({balance: 1}) == 1
do
  return int.abs(a)
end fn

fn wrong_arity(n: Int) -> Int
  example wrong_arity(1) == 1
do
  return int.max(n)
end fn

fn bad_cond(n: Int) -> Int
  example bad_cond(1) == 1
do
  if n then
    return 1
  end if
  return 0
end fn
